criteria.document_locator: Cross-border payroll is available to all customers today.
criteria.rationale: Approval for development establishes neither current availability nor customer entitlement. The deployed API rejects the feature.

criteria.document_locator: Enable `crossBorder=true` to expand into new markets immediately.
criteria.rationale: The only proposed action and its immediate benefit rely on a false present-tense capability promise. The unsupported parameter prevents the reader from acting on this introduction.
The enabling instruction is an additional consequential technical defect: payroll-prod-17 rejects crossBorder=true as unsupported.

findings.document_locator: Cross-border payroll is available to all customers today. Enable `crossBorder=true` to expand into new markets immediately.
findings.consequence: A planner is told the capability is available today and an engineer is directed to an unsupported API setting. The resulting plan cannot be carried out on the deployed API.
findings.fix: State that cross-border payroll is approved for development and currently unsupported, with no committed release date or entitlement. Remove the enabling instruction; domestic payroll remains the available capability.
